body: After GTC we will release a research integration of AlpaDreams into AlpaSim as a reference workflow for generative closed-loop simulation, enabling the community to build on it and adapt it to their own needs.

comments.body:
AlpaDreams is a multi-team endeavor that is currently being worked on; but, I'll leave it to the product managers to relay this information. 

Thanks for the interest and apologies that I cannot give more details.

title: When will AlpaDream be integrated into this repository?
